risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to foreign exchange restrictions and profit distribution rules in China, which could impact its ability to transfer funds out of China.

risks.title: China Dependency
risks.score_rationale: The company has significant exposure to China. ACM Shanghai and ACM Korea were added to the BIS Entity List in December 2024, restricting access to certain U.S. technologies and components.

risks.title: Liquidity Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company has substantial liquidity needs to fund R&D, capex, and working capital, which could impact its ability to finance growth.

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to customer default risk and accounts receivable management, which may affect operational cash flows.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company operates primarily in China and Korea with revenues in RMB and USD, exposing it to foreign exchange rate fluctuations.

risks.title: Export Control Compliance Risk
risks.score_rationale: ACM Shanghai faces significant U.S. and Dutch export controls on semiconductor technology and components. Inclusion on the BIS Entity List restricts access to U.S. technologies.

risks.title: Customer Loss Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in the highly competitive WFE (wafer fab equipment) market. Export restrictions could impair its ability to serve certain customers.

risks.title: Inspection and Delisting Risk (HFCA)
risks.score_rationale: The independent auditor EY is based in mainland China. If the PCAOB cannot fully inspect audit firms in China, ACM Research could be added to the HFCA's final list, potentially leading to delisting.

ai_positioning.summary: ACMR does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing.
